description: Grey paver tile in an 8x4 inch rectangular format from Pak Clay, made for outdoor paving such as driveways, paths and porches. The rectangular shape lays in brick, herringbone or stretcher patterns, and the neutral grey tone hides dust and tyre marks well. Pavers need a compacted, well-drained base with a slight fall, and for vehicle areas thickness should be confirmed with us first. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Octagon paver tile from Pak Clay, an eight-sided outdoor piece that gives paths, porches and courtyards a decorative geometric look. Octagons are often paired with small square infill pieces to complete the pattern, so plan the layout before ordering. Like all pavers, it performs best on a well-compacted, drained base laid with a gentle slope. For anything carrying vehicles, check thickness and suitability with us first. Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area and city for a dated written quote.

Square paver tile in a 4x4 inch format from Pak Clay, a compact outdoor piece for paths, borders, porches and driveways. The small size follows curves and edges easily and suits traditional pattern laying. Small pavers rely on tight joints, edge restraint and a well-compacted base, so plan the bedding before you buy. For vehicle areas, confirm thickness and suitability with us. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Square paver tile in a 6x6 inch format from Pak Clay, a mid-size outdoor piece for porches, garden paths, patios and driveways. It covers area faster than small pavers while still following gentle curves, and lays neatly in straight or diagonal grids. Use a compacted, well-drained base with a slight fall away from walls. For parking areas, check thickness and suitability with us first. Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
